main_issue: Who gets the working day before (and after) the Deepavali holiday off, given only two staff are needed and A, B and D all requested both days

A-B.evidence: A needs both days (T1,T5); B needs the first day but offers to work the second (T6). They never address each other directly, but B's concession on day two eases the conflict.

A-C.evidence: C offers to work those days in exchange for Christmas off (T3), which would help A's request, but A never responds and C says nothing more.

A-D.evidence: A: 'We can't both be off' (T15) and proposes a coin flip (T27); D: 'I'm not flipping a coin for my festival' (T31) and offers no alternative (T36).

B-C.evidence: C can work the days (T3) and B needs only the first day (T6), which are compatible, but neither refers to the other.

B-D.evidence: Both want the first day (T2, T8); B offers to work the second day (T6), but D keeps insisting on both and they never engage directly.

C-D.evidence: C offers to cover those days (T3) while D insists on being off (T4), which is compatible in principle, but they never address each other.
